9660.t: From ἐπιχαίρω (epikhaírō, “rejoice over someone”), from ἐπί (epí, “upon”) + χαίρω (khaírō, “I rejoice”).

9673.t: From ἔριφος (ériphos, “young goat, kid”) + -ιον (-ion, diminutive suffix).

9636.t: From ἐπιχειρέω (epĭkheiréō, “to endeavour, attempt to”) + -μα (-ma, result noun suffix).

9674.t: From the root of ἐρυθαίνω (eruthaínō, “to dye red, make blush”) and ἔρευθος (éreuthos, “redness, flush”) + -μα (-ma). Ultimately from Proto-Indo-European *h₁rewdʰ- (“red”).
